name: MarcoFazioRandom/Virtual-Joystick-Godot
description: Simple, customizable virtual joystick plugin for Godot supporting fixed, dynamic, and following modes with configurable dead zones, visibility options, and 2D/3D game compatibility for mobile touchscreen input.
score_rationale: Most starred Godot virtual joystick solution with 949 stars, MIT licensed, and the standard choice for adding mobile touch controls to Godot games.
summary: Virtual joystick plugin for Godot mobile games
